- name: Run development agent
  env:
    OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
  run: |
    cat .github/agent-prompts/repository-scope.md \
        .github/agent-prompts/autonomous-development.md \
        > /tmp/agent-instructions.md

    codex exec \
      --full-auto \
      - < /tmp/agent-instructions.md
